findings.issue: Task 1 says 'Verify-smoke: python3 -m py_compile orangetrack_source.py succeeds' but also says to run pytest tests/test_orangetrack_source.py beforehand. The existing test at line 153-154 asserts `assert 'heading' not in types` for SAMPLE_WITH_H5_HTML. Verified safe: SAMPLE_WITH_H5_HTML (lines 49-55) contains ONLY <h5> tags, and Task 1 preserves h5 as paragraph — so the assertion stays true. No conflict. Documented here for awareness.

findings.issue: Task 1 Details section says 'handled_tags' is defined 'inside _parse_content_encoded' rядом с _walk — verified correct (line 460). But task says 'Добавить "li" в handled_tags' as an option, and also says walker uses fallback `if name not in handled_tags: _walk(child)`. However ul/ol are NOT in handled_tags currently, so they already get recursed into via the fallback. Adding 'li' to handled_tags would cause the new explicit `name == 'li'` branch to be checked BEFORE the fallback — this is actually required for the new branch to work as intended. The task should make explicit that adding 'li' to handled_tags is mandatory (not optional 'для явности') because without adding 'li' to handled_tags, the `if name not in handled_tags: _walk(child)` fallback would still recurse INTO the <li> instead of letting the new `name == 'li'` branch trigger. Wait — actually the walk loop checks explicit branches before reaching the fallback `if name not in handled_tags`, so the branch order matters. Re-reading _walk: branches are checked sequentially: name=='p', name in ('h2','h3','h4'), name=='h5', name in ('h1','h6'), name=='figure', name=='img', name=='iframe', THEN the fallback. As long as `name == 'li'` branch is added BEFORE the fallback check, it will fire correctly regardless of handled_tags. The handled_tags update is truly optional/cosmetic. Task hint calling it optional is accurate but could be clarified.
findings.fix: Clarify in task that adding 'li' to handled_tags is cosmetic only — the new explicit branch must be placed before the fallback `if name not in handled_tags` check, which is the key requirement.

")` (one bullet char, plus newline '

The double-bullet in the tech-spec appears to be a copy/display artifact. But the

findings.issue: Task 3 smoke check (line 126) calls `_is_same_site('https://www.orangetrackdiecast.com/x', 'orangetrackdiecast.com')` — passing a bare netloc (no scheme) as the second argument `source_netloc`. But the `_render_paragraph_with_runs` helper is documented (step 2) to pass `source_netloc` computed via `urlparse(source_url).netloc`. When `source_url` is a well-formed URL, `urlparse(source_url).netloc` returns the host without scheme (e.g., 'orangetrackdiecast.com'). The smoke test is therefore internally consistent with the API contract. However the smoke test does not test the `removeprefix` www-normalization in the comparison step (second arg already lacks 'www.'). Non-blocking.
findings.fix: No action required; smoke test is valid. Consider adding a www-normalized variant to the smoke check for completeness.
